_about: Hand-authored, client-facing summaries for every service and action. Merged over documentation.json by tools/genmodel.py - the analysis fields remain the ground truth; this layer explains the wire contract to someone implementing a client. Keys: service = control path, action = action name.

/AlarmClock/Control.summary: Alarm scheduler for the zone. Lets a client create, list, update and delete alarms, and read/set the household clock settings those alarms run against (current time, time zone, time server, 12/24h and date formats, and the daily music-index refresh time). Alarms target a single room by UUID and can play a stream URI or a library playlist at a fixed volume, optionally grouping linked zones. Changes are announced through the evented AlarmListVersion.

actions.CreateAlarm: Creates a new alarm and returns its AssignedID, which is needed for UpdateAlarm and DestroyAlarm. StartLocalTime and Duration use 'HH:MM:SS'; Recurrence is a keyword such as ONCE, EVERYDAY, WEEKDAYS or WEEKENDS. RoomUUID selects the player, ProgramURI/ProgramMetaData choose what plays (a stream URI, or a Sonos playlist/library URI), PlayMode picks e.g. NORMAL or SHUFFLE_NOREPEAT, Volume is 0-100, and IncludeLinkedZones controls whether bonded players join in.
actions.DestroyAlarm: Deletes the alarm with the given ID (an AssignedID previously returned by CreateAlarm, or an id from ListAlarms). Returns nothing; the change shows up in AlarmListVersion.
actions.GetDailyIndexRefreshTime: Returns the 'HH:MM:SS' local time at which the player rebuilds the local music-library index each day.
actions.GetFormat: Returns the player's time and date display preferences (e.g. 12h vs 24h clock).
actions.GetHouseholdTimeAtStamp: Converts a monotonically-increasing household timestamp (as used in event and queue bookkeeping) into an absolute UTC time.
actions.GetTimeNow: Returns the player's current UTC time, local time, time zone and TimeGeneration (a counter that increments whenever the household clock is set - useful for detecting clock changes).
actions.GetTimeServer: Returns the configured household time-server address used to keep zone clocks in sync.
actions.GetTimeZone: Returns the current time zone index and whether DST is auto-adjusted. Use GetTimeZoneRule to resolve the index to a tz rule string.
actions.GetTimeZoneAndRule: Same as GetTimeZone but also returns the resolved CurrentTimeZone rule string in one call.
actions.GetTimeZoneRule: Looks up a time zone rule string (POSIX-style TZ spec) by Index.
actions.ListAlarms: Returns the full alarm list as an XML document plus CurrentAlarmListVersion. The version counter is the cheap way to poll for changes; it is also evented.
actions.SetDailyIndexRefreshTime: Changes the daily library-index refresh time ('HH:MM:SS').
actions.SetFormat: Sets the 12/24-hour time format and the date format.
actions.SetTimeNow: Sets the player's clock: DesiredTime is UTC 'HH:MM:SS'-style time plus a time zone so the local offset can be derived. Setting the clock bumps TimeGeneration.
actions.SetTimeServer: Sets the address of the household time server (host/IP used for clock sync).
actions.SetTimeZone: Selects the time zone by Index and toggles automatic DST adjustment.
actions.UpdateAlarm: Edits an existing alarm in place. ID is the AssignedID from CreateAlarm or ListAlarms; the remaining arguments carry the complete replacement definition (same fields as CreateAlarm), so callers should send the full record rather than a diff.

/AudioIn/Control.summary: The legacy hardware line-in service. Its SCPD (AudioIn1.xml) still ships and its route is still registered, but the service is not listed in the device description and every action dispatches to a stub that unconditionally faults 401. The feature was removed on this model; treat all six actions as dead surface - documented here so clients can recognise the fault. The actions below describe what the API used to do.

actions.StartTransmissionToGroup: Historically started streaming this player's analog line-in to the group identified by CoordinatorID, returning the resulting transport settings. In this build it always faults 401.
actions.StopTransmissionToGroup: Historically stopped line-in transmission to the group. In this build it always faults 401.
actions.SetAudioInputAttributes: Historically renamed the line-in source and set its icon. In this build it always faults 401.
actions.GetAudioInputAttributes: Historically returned the line-in source name and icon. In this build it always faults 401.
actions.SetLineInLevel: Historically set left/right line-in gain levels. In this build it always faults 401.
actions.GetLineInLevel: Historically returned the left/right line-in gain levels. In this build it always faults 401.

/DeviceProperties/Control.summary: Player identity, hardware features and local configuration: zone name/icon, serial/software/hardware versions, LED and button state, button lock, autoplay preferences (which room's line-in or TV input auto-plays here and at what volume), stereo-pair and home-theater satellite management, household id, config mode, and the room-detection chirp used during setup.

actions.AddBondedZones: Bonds additional players to this player via a ChannelMapSet (which member plays which channel).
actions.AddHTSatellite: Adds a surround/sub satellite to a home-theater group via HTSatChanMapSet.
actions.CreateStereoPair: Creates a stereo pair from two players, describing left/right assignment in ChannelMapSet.
actions.EnterConfigMode: Puts the player into a configuration mode (used during setup/registration); returns the resulting State.
actions.GetAutoplayLinkedZones: For a given autoplay Source, returns whether linked zones are grouped when autoplay triggers.
actions.GetAutoplayRoomUUID: For a given autoplay Source, returns the UUID of the room that will take over playback.
actions.GetAutoplayVolume: Returns the volume the player jumps to when the given autoplay Source activates.
actions.GetButtonLockState: Returns whether the player's physical buttons are locked (child-lock).
actions.GetButtonState: Returns the current physical button state (e.g. which buttons are pressed).
actions.GetHouseholdID: Returns the household identifier this player is registered to.
actions.GetLEDState: Returns whether the status LED is on or off.
actions.GetUseAutoplayVolume: Returns whether autoplay applies the configured autoplay volume (vs. keeping current volume).
actions.GetZoneAttributes: Returns the player's configured room name, icon and room configuration.
actions.GetZoneInfo: Returns identity and version info: serial number, software/hardware versions, IP and MAC addresses, flags and build metadata.
actions.RemoveBondedZones: Un-bonds zones described by ChannelMapSet; KeepGrouped controls whether playback grouping is preserved.
actions.RemoveHTSatellite: Removes a home-theater satellite by room UUID.
actions.RoomDetectionStartChirping: Plays the ultrasonic chirp used by Sonos room/speaker detection during setup; returns a PlayId to stop it.
actions.RoomDetectionStopChirping: Stops a chirp previously started by RoomDetectionStartChirping.
actions.SeparateStereoPair: Breaks a stereo pair described by ChannelMapSet back into two independent players.
actions.SetAutoplayLinkedZones: Sets whether autoplay groups linked zones for a Source.
actions.SetAutoplayRoomUUID: Sets which room UUID autoplay for a Source should target.
actions.SetAutoplayVolume: Sets the autoplay volume for a Source.
actions.SetButtonLockState: Locks or unlocks the player's physical buttons.
actions.SetLEDState: Turns the status LED on or off.
actions.SetUseAutoplayVolume: Enables or disables applying the autoplay volume.
actions.SetZoneAttributes: Sets the room name, icon and configuration shown to users.

/GroupManagement/Control.summary: Coordinator-facing group-membership service. Group members use these actions to join/leave a coordinator and to report buffering state; normal clients rarely call it, but it is advertised. Everything here operates on group members identified by MemberID.

actions.AddMember: Joins the calling member (MemberID + BootSeq) to this group. Returns the coordinator's current URI, the joined group UUID, volume/reset hints and transport settings so the new member can align playback.
actions.ReportTrackBufferingResult: Member-to-coordinator feedback of a buffering ResultCode for a track fetch. NOTE: the implementation unconditionally returns 402 in this build - effectively a non-functional stub.
actions.SetSourceAreaIds: Sets the group's desired source-area ids (used to steer which zone's content the group plays).

/HTControl/Control.summary: Home-theater control: IR repeater passthrough, LED feedback, and IR-remote learning so a TV remote can drive volume on the soundbar. Relevant to playbar-family hardware with an IR receiver.

actions.CommitLearnedIRCodes: Stores the codes captured by LearnIRCode under a remote Name.
actions.GetIRRepeaterState: Returns whether IR commands are retransmitted to the AV equipment.
actions.GetLEDFeedbackState: Returns the LED feedback state used to acknowledge IR-learned volume presses.
actions.IdentifyIRRemote: Asks the user to press buttons so the player can identify the remote layout, bounded by Timeout (seconds).
actions.IsRemoteConfigured: Returns whether an IR remote has been configured.
actions.LearnIRCode: Captures a single IRCode within Timeout during remote setup.
actions.SetIRRepeaterState: Enables or disables IR repeater passthrough.
actions.SetLEDFeedbackState: Sets the LED feedback pattern for IR volume presses.

/MediaRenderer/AVTransport/Control.summary: The playback engine of the zone - the largest service. Covers transport control (Play/Pause/Stop/Next/Previous), seeking, source selection via URIs and metadata, play modes and crossfade, the implicit playback queue (add/remove/reorder/clear), saved queues, group coordination transfer (one player handing the coordinator role to another, with full state snapshots), alarms/sleep timers, and Sonos-specific extras like autoplay and direct-control sessions. InstanceID is always 0. Many mutating actions take UpdateID for optimistic concurrency: pass the last queue UpdateID you saw and the call fails if the queue changed underneath you.

actions.AddMultipleURIsToQueue: Bulk-enqueues tracks into the implicit playback queue. EnqueuedURIs and EnqueuedURIMetaData are parallel lists (count must equal NumberOfURIs); DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued positions them, EnqueueAsNext inserts after the current track. ContainerURI/ContainerMetaData describe the source list itself. UpdateID guards against concurrent queue edits. Returns where the tracks landed, how many were added, and the new length/UpdateID.
actions.AddURIToQueue: Adds one track URI (+DIDL-Lite metadata) to the playback queue. DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued picks the position (0 = append), EnqueueAsNext inserts right after the current track. Returns the 1-based position where it landed and tracks actually added.
actions.AddURIToSavedQueue: Adds a track to a saved queue identified by ObjectID at AddAtIndex. Returns counts and a NewUpdateID for that queue.
actions.BackupQueue: Persists the current playback queue to flash so it survives reboot.
actions.BecomeCoordinatorOfStandaloneGroup: Makes this player coordinate the standalone group it belongs to; returns the coordinator id and new group id. Used in group rebuild flows.
actions.BecomeGroupCoordinator: Bulk state-transfer: this player takes over as group coordinator, receiving the previous coordinator's complete transport/queue/alarm/sleep state in the arguments (TransportSettings, CurrentQueueTrackList, member list, etc.). Nothing is read from arg descriptors - the handler forwards the whole blob.
actions.BecomeGroupCoordinatorAndSource: Like BecomeGroupCoordinator but also transfers the audio source state (CurrentAVTTrackList, CurrentSourceState, ResumePlayback flag) so the new coordinator continues the same source.
actions.ChangeCoordinator: Asks this coordinator to hand coordination to NewCoordinator, carrying the current transport settings and URI so playback continues; RestartSink controls whether the sink restarts.
actions.ChangeTransportSettings: Applies a new TransportSettings blob (play state, mode, etc.) to the current URI - used when a group coordinator pushes state to members.
actions.ConfigureSleepTimer: Sets a sleep timer that fades playback out after NewSleepTimerDuration ('HH:MM:SS').
actions.CreateSavedQueue: Creates a new named saved queue containing one initial track (EnqueuedURI + metadata) and returns its AssignedObjectID plus queue stats.
actions.DelegateGroupCoordinationTo: Hands the coordinator role to NewCoordinator. RejoinGroup controls whether this player stays as a member; ClearSource (added in 86.10) controls whether it drops the source.
actions.EndDirectControlSession: Ends a cloud/direct-control playback session, returning the player to normal UPnP control.
actions.GetCrossfadeMode: Returns whether crossfade between tracks is enabled.
actions.GetCurrentTransportActions: Returns the actions currently legal for this source as a CSV (e.g. 'Play,Pause,Stop,Seek') - depends on the stream type and capabilities, so poll it rather than assuming.
actions.GetDeviceCapabilities: Returns what media this player can play/record and its recording quality modes.
actions.GetMediaInfo: Returns metadata about the current media source: track count and duration, current/next URIs + metadata, and the medium (queue, stream, line-in) - i.e. what container is loaded rather than where playback is within it (use GetPositionInfo for that).
actions.GetPositionInfo: Returns where playback sits inside the media: current track number/URI/metadata, track duration, relative and absolute position times, and track counts.
actions.GetRemainingSleepTimerDuration: Returns the time left on the sleep timer and the timer generation counter.
actions.GetRunningAlarmProperties: If an alarm is currently ringing, returns its ID, group and the logged start time.
actions.GetTransportInfo: Returns transport state (PLAYING/PAUSED_PLAYBACK/STOPPED/TRANSITIONING), status and speed.
actions.GetTransportSettings: Returns the current play mode (NORMAL/REPEAT_ALL/SHUFFLE…) and recording quality mode.
actions.Next: Skips to the next track in the queue. Faults (typically 711/701 family) if the current source doesn't support skipping.
actions.NotifyDeletedURI: Tells the player a URI it may have queued has been deleted from the server so it can drop or skip it.
actions.Pause: Pauses playback. Only valid while playing; faults on sources that can't pause.
actions.Play: Starts or resumes playback. Speed selects the rate - '1' is normal; fractional rate strings select slower/faster trick-play on sources that support it.
actions.Previous: Skips back to the previous track.
actions.RemoveAllTracksFromQueue: Clears the implicit playback queue entirely.
actions.RemoveTrackFromQueue: Removes the queued track identified by ObjectID (track object id), guarded by UpdateID for optimistic concurrency.
actions.RemoveTrackRangeFromQueue: Removes NumberOfTracks consecutive tracks starting at 1-based StartingIndex; returns the NewUpdateID.
actions.ReorderTracksInQueue: Moves a run of tracks (StartingIndex + NumberOfTracks) to InsertBefore within the queue, UpdateID-guarded.
actions.ReorderTracksInSavedQueue: Rewrites a saved queue's ordering from TrackList/NewPositionList; returns length change and new UpdateID.
actions.RunAlarm: Server-driven 'fire this alarm now' trigger carrying the full alarm definition - used internally when an alarm goes off; also useful for testing alarm playback.
actions.SaveQueue: Saves the current playback queue as a named saved queue (Title); ObjectID selects an existing saved queue to overwrite. Returns AssignedObjectID.
actions.Seek: Repositions playback. Unit selects the seek mode: TRACK_NR jumps to a track number, REL_TIME seeks to 'HH:MM:SS' from track start, TIME_DELTA does a relative jump. Parsing is lenient (numeric prefixes accepted, trailing junk ignored) but the accepted Unit set and the semantics depend on whether the source is indexed or streamed - a request can be accepted yet ignored downstream, so check GetPositionInfo after seeking.
actions.SetAVTransportURI: Loads a new source: a track/stream URI plus its DIDL-Lite metadata. This is how a client starts a radio stream or a file URI - the previous queue position is not implied; you typically call Play afterwards.
actions.SetNextAVTransportURI: Sets up gapless playback: the URI + metadata that should follow the current track, so the decoder can pre-buffer it.
actions.SetPlayMode: Sets play mode: NORMAL, REPEAT_ALL, REPEAT_ONE, SHUFFLE, SHUFFLE_NOREPEAT, SHUFFLE_REPEAT_ONE (exact accepted set is enforced).
actions.SnoozeAlarm: Snoozes the currently ringing alarm by Duration ('HH:MM:SS').
actions.StartAutoplay: Starts autoplay for a source: plays ProgramURI (+metadata) at the configured autoplay volume, optionally grouping linked zones; ResetVolumeAfter restores volume afterwards.
actions.Stop: Stops playback and clears transport position.

/MediaRenderer/ConnectionManager/Control.summary: Standard UPnP ConnectionManager for the renderer half of the device. On Sonos this is mostly vestigial (playback isn't pull-pushed through UPnP connections), so connection ids are typically empty - but the three actions are the real spec.

actions.GetCurrentConnectionIDs: Returns the CSV list of active connection ids (usually empty on a zone player).
actions.GetCurrentConnectionInfo: Returns per-connection detail (peer manager, protocol info, direction, status) for a ConnectionID previously returned by GetCurrentConnectionIDs.
actions.GetProtocolInfo: Returns the Source and Sink protocol-info CSVs - the MIME-type/protocol strings this renderer can play.

/MediaRenderer/GroupRenderingControl/Con.summary: Group-level volume control. These actions apply to the whole group coordinated by this player - SetGroupVolume applies the same absolute volume to every member, while SetRelativeGroupVolume keeps the members' relative offsets (that's the action Sonos apps call for the group volume slider). SnapshotGroupVolume exists so a ramp/group adjustment can later be balanced.

actions.GetGroupMute: Returns the group mute state (any/all-muted semantics per the coordinator).
actions.SetGroupMute: Mutes or unmutes every player in the group.
actions.SetGroupVolume: Sets every member of the group to the same absolute DesiredVolume (0-100).
actions.SetRelativeGroupVolume: Adjusts group volume by a signed Adjustment while preserving per-player offsets; returns the resulting NewVolume. Prefer this over SetGroupVolume for slider UIs.
actions.SnapshotGroupVolume: Captures per-member volumes so a subsequent group adjustment can be made consistently.

/MediaRenderer/Queue/Control.summary: The multi-queue registry: explicit saved/independent queues addressed by QueueID, separate from the implicit playback queue AVTransport edits. Provides create/attach/browse/mutate operations with optimistic concurrency - every mutating action takes the queue's last UpdateID and returns the new one, and a stale UpdateID faults. AttachQueue is how a client adopts a queue owned by another context.

actions.AddMultipleURIs: Bulk-adds tracks to an explicit queue: EnqueuedURIsAndMetaData holds NumberOfURIs packed URI+metadata entries; positioning via DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued or EnqueueAsNext. UpdateID-guarded.
actions.AddURI: Adds a single track (+DIDL-Lite metadata) to the queue at DesiredFirstTrackNumberEnqueued (or after the current track with EnqueueAsNext). Returns its position, count added and the new UpdateID.
actions.AttachQueue: Attaches to a queue owned by QueueOwnerID, returning the QueueID to use in subsequent calls plus the owner context.
actions.Backup: Persists the queue registry to flash (trackqueue.rsq) so queues survive reboot.
actions.Browse: Reads back a queue's contents: starting at StartingIndex, up to RequestedCount tracks, returned as a DIDL-Lite Result document with NumberReturned/TotalMatches and the queue's UpdateID.
actions.CreateQueue: Creates a new queue owned by QueueOwnerID with a policy (QueuePolicy), returning its QueueID.
actions.RemoveTrackRange: Removes NumberOfTracks consecutive tracks starting at StartingIndex; returns NewUpdateID.
actions.ReorderTracks: Moves a run of tracks to InsertBefore within the queue; UpdateID-guarded.
actions.ReplaceAllTracks: Atomically replaces the whole queue contents: new tracks from ContainerURI/ContainerMetaData plus packed EnqueuedURIsAndMetaData, with CurrentTrackIndex/NewCurrentTrackIndices pointing at what should be playing. Bulk transfer - no per-arg capacity limits.
actions.SaveAsSonosPlaylist: Saves the queue as a Sonos playlist (Title); ObjectID selects an existing playlist to overwrite. Returns AssignedObjectID.

/MediaRenderer/RenderingControl/Control.summary: Per-player audio rendering: volume (linear 0-100 and dB), mute, bass/treble/loudness and extended EQ, fixed (line-out level) output mode, headphone detection, room-calibration enable, and volume ramps used by alarms/sleep timers. Channel is 'Master' or 'LF'/'RF' for stereo pairs. NOTE: several actions are deliberately neutered on this hardware (e.g. GetBass is a confirmed no-op) - check each action's status before trusting it.

actions.GetBass: Returns bass level - BUT it is neutered on this build: the implementation is a confirmed no-op stub, so the returned CurrentBass is meaningless. GetEQ(EQType='Bass') is the working path.
actions.GetEQ: Reads an EQ parameter by EQType (e.g. Bass/Treble/Loudness-style ids) from the audio pipeline.
actions.GetHeadphoneConnected: Returns whether headphones are plugged in (players with a headphone jack).
actions.GetLoudness: Returns the loudness-compensation setting for a Channel.
actions.GetMute: Returns mute state for a Channel ('Master' unless addressing a stereo-pair side).
actions.GetOutputFixed: Returns whether output is at fixed level (for line-out/receiver use) vs. variable.
actions.GetRoomCalibrationStatus: Returns whether room calibration (Trueplay) is enabled and available on this player.
actions.GetSupportsOutputFixed: Returns whether this hardware supports fixed-level output mode at all.
actions.GetTreble: Returns treble level - same neutering caveat as GetBass may apply; GetEQ is the reliable path.
actions.GetVolume: Returns the linear volume for a Channel (0-100).
actions.GetVolumeDB: Returns the volume in decibels (scaled; see GetVolumeDBRange for this player's range).
actions.GetVolumeDBRange: Returns the dB volume range this player supports.
actions.RampToVolume: Starts a timed volume ramp to DesiredVolume of type RampType (used for alarm/sleep-timer fades); returns RampTime.
actions.ResetBasicEQ: Resets bass/treble/loudness and stereo balance to neutral; returns the resulting values.
actions.ResetExtEQ: Resets the extended EQ band EQType.
actions.RestoreVolumePriorToRamp: Undoes a previous RampToVolume, restoring the earlier volume.
actions.SetBass: Sets the bass level - neutered like GetBass on this build; use SetEQ with the bass EQType instead.
actions.SetChannelMap: Assigns left/right channels to players in a stereo pair via ChannelMap.
actions.SetEQ: Sets an EQ parameter (EQType, e.g. bass/treble/loudness id) to DesiredValue - the working EQ path.
actions.SetLoudness: Enables or disables loudness compensation for a Channel.
actions.SetOutputFixed: Switches between fixed and variable output level where supported.
actions.SetRelativeVolume: Adjusts volume by a signed Adjustment; returns NewVolume. Safer than absolute SetVolume for slider deltas.
actions.SetRoomCalibrationStatus: Enables or disables Trueplay room calibration.
actions.SetTreble: Sets treble level - same neuter caveat; prefer SetEQ.
actions.SetVolume: Sets the linear volume for a Channel (0-100).
actions.SetVolumeDB: Sets the volume in decibels within the range reported by GetVolumeDBRange.

/MediaRenderer/VirtualLineIn/Control.summary: Treats a networked line-in source as a virtual transport on this player - transport-style control (Play/Pause/Stop/Next/Previous/SetVolume) plus Start/StopTransmission to run the session. It's the 'line-in from another player' surface.

actions.Play: Starts/resumes the virtual line-in source at the given Speed ('1' normal).
actions.Previous: Steps the virtual line-in transport back.
actions.SetVolume: Sets the playback volume for the line-in session.
actions.StartTransmission: Begins receiving the line-in stream from the given CoordinatorID; returns the resulting transport settings.
actions.StopTransmission: Ends the line-in transmission from the given coordinator.

/MediaServer/ConnectionManager/Control.summary: Standard UPnP ConnectionManager for the embedded MediaServer (the side that serves the local library). Same three actions as the renderer variant.

actions.GetCurrentConnectionIDs: Returns the CSV list of active connection ids (normally empty).
actions.GetCurrentConnectionInfo: Returns per-connection detail for the media-server side. Unlike the renderer twin it takes no ConnectionID argument and reports the single active/default connection.
actions.GetProtocolInfo: Returns the Source/Sink protocol-info CSVs the media server supports.

/MediaServer/ContentDirectory/Control.summary: The local music-library service. Browse is the workhorse: hierarchical object ids (folders, artists, albums, playlists, shares) returning DIDL-Lite XML with paging via StartingIndex/RequestedCount and change detection via UpdateID/GetSystemUpdateID. Also covers object create/update/delete for editable containers, prefix lookups used by the app, share-index refresh control, and sort/browse capability queries. NOTE: the Search action is gone in this build - it exists in 25.2-era firmware but has been removed here.

actions.Browse: Browses the library tree. ObjectID selects the container (e.g. 'Q:0' the queue, 'A:ARTIST', 'SQ:' saved queues, 'S:' shares, music-service object ids); BrowseFlag is BrowseDirectChildren or BrowseMetadata; Filter/SortCriteria follow the CDS spec. Returns DIDL-Lite Result, counts, and an UpdateID that changes when the container does - cache on it.
actions.CreateObject: Creates an object (e.g. a playlist entry) inside ContainerID; Elements is a DIDL-Lite fragment. Returns the new ObjectID.
actions.FindPrefix: Locates the object prefix for ObjectID - returns the StartingIndex under the given Prefix and an UpdateID (used to map an item back to its container position).
actions.GetAlbumArtistDisplayOption: Returns whether the library groups by album artist or contributing artist.
actions.GetAllPrefixLocations: Returns all container prefixes that contain ObjectID (an item can live under several indices).
actions.GetBrowseable: Returns whether the local library share is currently marked browseable.
actions.GetLastIndexChange: Returns the timestamp/id of the last library reindex - cheap polling point for 'did the library change'.
actions.GetSearchCapabilities: Returns which DIDL properties Search would accept - vestigial since Search itself is removed in this build.
actions.GetShareIndexInProgress: Returns whether a library reindex is currently running.
actions.GetSortCapabilities: Returns which DIDL properties can be used in Browse SortCriteria.
actions.GetSystemUpdateID: Returns the global library UpdateID - compare before/after to detect any change.
actions.RefreshShareIndex: Triggers a rescan of the configured music shares.
actions.RequestResort: Re-sorts the library index using SortOrder.
actions.SetBrowseable: Marks the library share browseable or not.
actions.UpdateObject: Rewrites an object's metadata: CurrentTagValue -> NewTagValue DIDL fragments for ObjectID.

/MusicServices/Control.summary: SMAPI music-service discovery: which streaming services are configured on the household and their descriptor metadata (capabilities, auth type, presentation maps). The account credentials themselves live under SystemProperties.

actions.GetSessionId: Returns the session id used to authenticate SMAPI calls for the given ServiceId + Username.
actions.ListAvailableServices: Returns the full music-service descriptor list (XML: service ids, names, capabilities, auth policies, presentation metadata) plus the flat type list and a version counter for change detection.
actions.UpdateAvailableServices: Forces a refresh of the cached service descriptor list from the cloud/catalog.

/QPlay/Control.summary: Tencent QPlay handshake - the single-action auth protocol used by QQ Music clients on Chinese-market zones. The device description advertises QPlay:2 capability via qq:X_QPlay_SoftwareCapability rather than a serviceType.

actions.QPlayAuth: Auth exchange: client sends a Seed string; the player returns Code, MID and DID used to derive the session key. Faults if the seed doesn't decode.

/SystemProperties/Control.summary: A generic key/value store plus the music-service account manager. SetString/GetString/Remove are a free-form property bag that many features lean on (client-facing settings ride through it). The account actions manage per-service credentials: legacy login (AddAccountX), OAuth (AddOAuthAccountX and friends keyed by AccountUDN), nickname/edit/remove, and credential refresh. Two SCPD-advertised actions are dead in this build: ProvisionCredentialedTrialAccountX (name string absent - hard-removed) and ResetThirdPartyCredentials (string present but unreferenced - soft-removed); both fault 401 on the wire.

actions.AddAccountX: Registers a music-service account with legacy credentials (AccountType id, AccountID username, AccountPassword); returns the AccountUDN used by all other account actions.
actions.AddOAuthAccountX: Registers an OAuth music-service account: AccountType plus token/key/device-id/authorization-code/redirect metadata and optional UserIdHashCode/AccountTier. Returns AccountUDN and the service-provided AccountNickname.
actions.DoPostUpdateTasks: Runs bookkeeping that should execute after a firmware update (data migration, cached-state rebuild).
actions.EditAccountMd: Replaces the metadata (Md) blob for an account.
actions.EditAccountPasswordX: Changes the password on a legacy-credential account.
actions.EnableRDM: Enables or disables Retail Demo Mode on the player.
actions.GetRDM: Returns whether Retail Demo Mode is enabled.
actions.GetString: Reads a property value by VariableName from the key/value store.
actions.GetWebCode: Returns a short WebCode for the given AccountType - used to link an account via the provider's web flow.
actions.RefreshAccountCredentialsX: Refreshes OAuth credentials (token/key) for an existing AccountUID.
actions.Remove: Deletes VariableName from the key/value store.
actions.RemoveAccount: Deletes a music-service account by AccountType + AccountID.
actions.ReplaceAccountX: Swaps the account behind AccountUDN for new credentials (NewAccountID/password or OAuth token set), returning NewAccountUDN.
actions.SetAccountNicknameX: Sets the display nickname for an AccountUDN.
actions.SetString: Writes VariableName=StringValue into the property store.

/ZoneGroupTopology/Control.summary: Zone topology and household management. GetZoneGroupState is the famous one: a single XML snapshot listing every group, member, coordinator and source - the fastest way to map a household. The rest covers software update control, mobile-device registration, diagnostics upload and coordinator callbacks for alarms/unresponsive members.

actions.BeginSoftwareUpdate: Starts a firmware update: UpdateURL to fetch from, Flags controlling behaviour (e.g. forced downgrade), ExtraOptions for transport options.
actions.CheckForUpdate: Asks whether a firmware update is available; UpdateType selects the channel, CachedOnly avoids the network fetch, Version filters; returns the UpdateItem XML.
actions.GetZoneGroupAttributes: Returns the household's group name/id, the member UUIDs, and the Muse household id.
actions.GetZoneGroupState: Returns the complete zone topology as an XML document: every group, its coordinator, member players, and what each is playing. The single most useful call for mapping a household.
actions.RegisterMobileDevice: Registers a mobile controller (name, UDN, IP:port) so the zone can push callbacks to it.
actions.ReportAlarmStartedRunning: Member-to-coordinator callback: reports that an alarm started running (drives 'alarm is playing' indicators).
actions.ReportUnresponsiveDevice: Reports a missing/unresponsive DeviceUUID with a DesiredAction (e.g. remove it from groups) so the coordinator can heal topology.
actions.SubmitDiagnostics: Uploads a diagnostics bundle; IncludeControllers widens scope, Type selects the dump kind; returns a DiagnosticID to quote to support.
